items.caption: A Shang oracle-script form of 妹 is organized around a compact central structure with extended strokes above and to the right.
items.alt: Black oracle-script glyph on white, with a dense central form, tall upper strokes, and a long descending stroke on the right.
items.selection_reason: This legible, identified early form adds a visual example to the documented oracle-script tradition. The sources disagree about how some oracle-bone uses were read, so the shape alone does not establish the word’s meaning.

limitations.text: The dating and interpretation of the oracle-bone uses remain unsettled: proposals include dawn-related, place-name, and negative readings. This glyph shows a form, but cannot resolve those readings or establish a path to the kinship sense “younger sister.”
